name: Soitec SA
blurb: Soitec SA is a French semiconductor materials company founded in 1992 that develops and manufactures engineered substrates used in smartphones, automotive electronics, and 5G infrastructure. Its core product lines include Radio Frequency Silicon-on-Insulator (RF-SOI) wafers for smartphone front-end modules, FD-SOI substrates for low-power chips, Piezoelectric-on-Insulator (POI) RF filters, and RF gallium nitride for sub-6GHz and mmWave 5G systems. The company operates across Asia, Europe, and the United States with approximately 1,991 employees and a market capitalization of roughly €5.6 billion. Soitec holds a dominant position in the engineered substrate niche, supplying major semiconductor fabs and OEMs globally.
recent: As of mid-May 2026, Soitec shares trade around €152–155, well off their 52-week high of €180 but up sharply over the prior year (+163%) following a reverse stock split. Trailing-twelve-month revenue has contracted 14.3% to €784M and net income has fallen nearly 90% year-over-year, reflecting weakness in smartphone demand — a risk Morningstar analysts flagged in a March 2026 note that also cited silicon photonics as a potential long-term upside catalyst. The company's next scheduled earnings release is May 27, 2026, which will be closely watched for signs of stabilization in mobile volumes.
